capabilities: Catalog all notes containing a specified source property with a URL value
Search clipping titles and tags with real-time updates
Filter the catalog by tags and exclude directories
Sort clippings by date, title, or path
Open the catalog from the command palette or sidebar
extras: README states the plugin reads only local vault notes and sends no data to external servers.
problem: Web clippings saved to a vault are scattered across folders, so there is no single view to browse, search, and organize them.
summary: Catalog view that lists, searches, and filters vault notes identified as web clippings by a configurable source property.
